title: TD-µT: reprogrammable dual-engine protocol emulator ASIC
description:
A reprogrammable protocol emulator ASIC for Tiny Tapeout on IHP CMOS5L: two microcode engines (physical layer and protocol layer) coupled by a backpressured FIFO, with a generic hardware bit pipe (NRZI, bit stuffing, CRC) for receive and transmit, a glitch filter and digital bit-clock recovery. UART, SPI, I2C, USB low-speed and 10 Mbit Ethernet receive run as programs loaded over the pins. RTL in Hardcaml; assembler and loader in Axiom.

Entry for Jane Street's open-source protocol emulator ASIC challenge.
notes: Claude (Anthropic) was used for tests, documentation, debugging and review; the assembler and loader (tools/tdasm) was written by Claude. See the AI Usage Disclosure in README.md.
